text:
emma: Blocking on release: CI failed because regen produced a trivial types file order flip in the sample-app onboarding change. changelog-bot suggested a minor bump and the semver guard prevented publishing.
ci-bot: buildkite: #5134 failed during `yarn regen` -> git diff check :x:
raj: Paste of the tiny diff:
```diff
- export interface OnboardParams { company?: string; name: string }
+ export interface OnboardParams { name: string; company?: string }
```
noah: This is the nondeterministic OpenAPI->typegen ordering again. Our typegen has a `--stable` flag that canonicalizes keys but it's not on by default. That opt-in is causing repeated churn.
changelog-bot: changelog: Detected changes in tracked files -> suggested bump: minor
tara: Short-term fixes we can do right now: 1) add generated globs (src/openapi/**.generated.ts, src/generated/**) to .semver-ignore so the changelog bot treats these as docs-only, 2) run `yarn typegen --stable` and commit the golden files, 3) set REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false in CI to avoid interactive timeouts during sample-app e2e.
emma: I'll push the CI env var change. Raj, can you run the stable typegen and commit?
raj: Ran `yarn typegen --stable` locally and committed src/openapi/onboard.generated.ts. Also added `src/openapi/**/*.generated.ts` to .semver-ignore. Pushing now.
ci-bot: raj pushed a fix, retriggering build :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: buildkite: #5134 rerun failed 1: sample-app e2e timed out waiting for onboarding prompt :x:
emma: Looks like some CI runners still didn't pick up REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false. Our matrix has multiple job definitions; need to add the env at the workflow level. I'll patch that.
noah: Follow-ups beyond the short-term: 1) make deterministic output the default in typegen (flip `--stable` to on by default), 2) add a lightweight pre-merge check in CI: `yarn typegen --stable --check` to fail PRs that forgot to regen, 3) update PR template to include "run yarn typegen --stable" and a regen checkbox, 4) consider a husky precommit hook (or lint-staged step) for devs to catch golden file differences locally.
changelog-bot: After consulting .semver-ignore, no releasable change detected. No bump suggested.
ci-bot: buildkite: #5134 rerun passed :white_check_mark:
emma: Nice. I'll open a tiny RFC to default deterministic typegen and file the CI pre-merge check PR. Also adding a short devex doc about generated file naming (.generated.ts) and semver-ignore usage.
raj: One note: infra should pin node/npm across runners (node 20) because prettier/tsc minor differences can change emitted formatting. I'll ping infra.
tara: Thanks all. Merging once the release branch is green. :rocket:
